items.problem: Startup diagnostics hid managed HRESULT 0x8001010E and did not distinguish an SDK-generated Program.Main failure from authored app code.
items.evidence: lessons.json errors_encountered COMException entry; session-log.txt lines 4635-4642 and 4921-4933; migration-score.json score 0 because both features were unavailable.
items.root_cause: Event 1000 wrapper code drove hint selection while event 1026's actionable HRESULT was discarded; prose did not identify generated entry-point provenance.
items.change: Parse/report managedCode, select the apartment hint from it, and direct pre-callback Application.Start failures to a same-version pristine scaffold comparison instead of a speculative Program.cs rewrite. Tier 1 carries the non-ignorable signal; targeted Tier 3 text is still needed because deciding whether the frame is generated and repairing a matched toolchain requires judgment.
items.expected_effect: The next managed apartment startup crash reports 0x8001010E and sends the agent directly to scaffold/toolchain isolation, avoiding ineffective entry-point rewrites.
items.falsifiable_check: Given an event 1000 code 0xe0434352 plus event 1026 HRESULT 0x8001010E and the Application Object message, Test-AppLaunch JSON contains managedCode=0x8001010e and the hint says not to replace generated Program.cs.

items.problem: The skill prescribed nonexistent winapp build and omitted the launch helper's completed host-architecture layout requirement.
items.root_cause: Compilation responsibility was assigned to the wrong CLI.
items.change: Use copyable native dotnet build -p:Platform=<host-arch> commands and explicitly serialize build before launch. No Tier 1 change was chosen because Validate-UwpMigration already performs the enforced host-architecture build; this gap was in the interactive Step 3 command contract.
items.expected_effect: Interactive validation creates the layout Test-AppLaunch expects without an invalid command or stale-output race.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, no winapp build invocation occurs and the first Test-AppLaunch call does not report missing bin/x64/Debug or an incomplete in-flight layout.

items.problem: No repair pattern covered scaffold root namespace versus retained copied-page namespace errors.
items.root_cause: Bootstrap preserves internally consistent copied XAML class namespaces while the new shell uses the target root namespace.
items.change: Add a focused common-build-error pattern for explicit imports/qualification and warn against partial global renaming. A script rewrite was not chosen because selecting which namespace boundary to import depends on XAML x:Class and source topology.
items.expected_effect: Agents resolve the first namespace-boundary build cleanly without destabilizing XAML/code-behind identity.
items.falsifiable_check: When copied MainPage and scaffold App use different namespaces, the next migration fixes CS0246/CS0103 with imports or qualification in one edit and leaves matching x:Class namespaces unchanged.

deferred_to_human: Tier 0: verify the benchmark's installed Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK.WinUI.CSharp.Templates 0.0.5-alpha is intentionally paired with the post-action Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK 2.3.1; update the setup image/template pin as a matched set if a pristine scaffold reproduces 0x8001010E.
